en.standbyHint: Pause your desktop. Your place will be here when you return.

en.restartHint: A fresh start, with the familiar XP boot sequence.
en.switchHint: Return to the welcome screen and keep your desktop ready.
en.logoffHint: Step away from your session and return to the welcome screen.
en.choose: What would you like to do?
en.offTitle: Ghazi XP is now turned off.
en.offMessage: It is now safe to close this window.
en.goodbye: Thanks for exploring my little corner of the internet.
en.standbyMessage: Your desktop is right where you left it.
en.wakeHint: Press a key or click Wake up to return.
